# Python script to label trees for PAML model=2 (only neo_genes trees). This will allow the outgroups (which have no sex-autosome fusion) to have distinct dN/dS estimations than for the group of interest (with sex-autosome fusion). The script will add a "#" to the tree branches with a number associated with the category (outgroup or ingroup). 

```{python, eval=FALSE}
import glob
import os
import re

import pandas as pd

from newick_utils import (
    Node,
    parse_newick,
    find_mrca,
    is_descendant,
    check_outgroup_monophyly,
)

# =============================================================================
# 0. CONFIGURATION
# =============================================================================
IQTREE_OUT_DIR = "/dss/dsslegfs01/pr53da/pr53da-dss-0036/projects/2025__neosex/neosex_project/fusion_dating/Psittaciformes/neo_genes/PAML_constraint_str"
OUTPUT_TREE_DIR = IQTREE_OUT_DIR

# Define all outgroup species here 
OUTGROUPS = {"Str_cam", "Ans_ans", "Fal_per"}

os.makedirs(OUTPUT_TREE_DIR, exist_ok=True)


# =============================================================================
# 1. SERIALIZE A LABELED TREE BACK TO PAML-STYLE NEWICK
# =============================================================================
def _fmt_length(length):
    """Format a branch length in plain fixed-point notation, never
    scientific ('1e-06' style). PAML's Newick parser likely accepts
    scientific notation fine, but there's no reason to rely on that
    assumption when a fixed-point format is unambiguous and trivial."""
    if length is None:
        return ""
    return f"{length:.10f}"


def serialize(node, is_root=True):
    if node.is_leaf():
        s = f"{node.name}: {_fmt_length(node.length)}"
    else:
        inner = ",".join(serialize(c, is_root=False) for c in node.children)
        s = f"({inner})"
        if node.length is not None:
            s += f": {_fmt_length(node.length)}"
    if node.label is not None:
        s += f" #{node.label}"
    if is_root:
        s += ";"
    return s


def clean_taxon_name(raw_name):
    """Sanitize taxon names by removing branch lengths, quotes, and punctuation."""
    if not raw_name:
        return ""
    # Strip branch length colon if present
    name = raw_name.split(":")[0]
    # Strip quotes, semicolons, and trailing whitespaces
    name = name.strip("';\" \t\n\r")
    return name


# =============================================================================
# 2. LABEL A SINGLE TREE
# =============================================================================
def label_tree_for_fusion(tree, outgroup_taxa, foreground_taxa):
    is_clean, rerooted, mrca_node, msg = check_outgroup_monophyly(
        tree, outgroup_taxa, foreground_taxa
    )
    if not is_clean:
        return False, None, msg

    mrca_node.label = "1"

    def label_descendants(node):
        for child in node.children:
            child.label = "2"
            label_descendants(child)

    label_descendants(mrca_node)

    return True, rerooted, "OK"


# =============================================================================
# 3. BATCH RUN -- auto-discover every <gene>/<gene>_constrained.treefile
# =============================================================================
def main():
    treefiles = sorted(
        glob.glob(os.path.join(IQTREE_OUT_DIR, "*", "*_constrained.treefile"))
    )
    if not treefiles:
        print(f">>> No *_constrained.treefile files found under {IQTREE_OUT_DIR}/*/")
        return

    print(f">>> Found {len(treefiles)} constrained tree files")

    needs_review = []
    labeled_ok = []

    for in_path in treefiles:
        gene = os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(in_path))

        with open(in_path) as f:
            newick_str = f.read()

        try:
            tree = parse_newick(newick_str)
        except Exception as e:
            needs_review.append(
                {"Gene": gene, "Treefile": in_path, "Reason": f"parse_error: {e}"}
            )
            continue

        # Clean all extracted leaf names explicitly
        raw_leaves = tree.leaf_names()
        all_leaves = {clean_taxon_name(leaf) for leaf in raw_leaves}

        # Check if all required outgroups are present in the tree
        missing_ogs = OUTGROUPS - all_leaves
        if missing_ogs:
            needs_review.append(
                {"Gene": gene, "Treefile": in_path,
                 "Reason": f"outgroup taxon/taxa '{', '.join(missing_ogs)}' not present in this tree (Found: {all_leaves})"}
            )
            continue

        # Ingroup is all leaves minus the outgroups
        foreground = sorted(all_leaves - OUTGROUPS)

        success, labeled_tree, msg = label_tree_for_fusion(tree, OUTGROUPS, foreground)

        if not success:
            needs_review.append({"Gene": gene, "Treefile": in_path, "Reason": msg})
            continue

        gene_out_dir = os.path.join(OUTPUT_TREE_DIR, gene)
        os.makedirs(gene_out_dir, exist_ok=True)
        out_path = os.path.join(gene_out_dir, f"{gene}_labeled.treefile")
        with open(out_path, "w") as f:
            f.write(serialize(labeled_tree) + "\n")

        labeled_ok.append({"Gene": gene, "Treefile": out_path, "Status": "labeled_stem_crown"})

    labeled_df = pd.DataFrame(labeled_ok)
    review_df = pd.DataFrame(needs_review)

    if len(labeled_df):
        labeled_df.to_csv(
            os.path.join(OUTPUT_TREE_DIR, "labeling_summary.tsv"), sep="\t", index=False
        )
    if len(review_df):
        review_df.to_csv(
            os.path.join(OUTPUT_TREE_DIR, "needs_manual_review.tsv"), sep="\t", index=False
        )

    print(f"\n>>> Successfully labeled: {len(labeled_df)} / {len(treefiles)} genes")
    print(f">>> Flagged for manual review: {len(review_df)} genes")
    if len(review_df):
        print("\n=== GENES NEEDING MANUAL REVIEW ===")
        print(review_df.to_string(index=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```
